candidates.title: Hardwired
candidates.synopsis: After a tragic accident Luke Gibson is left with critical injuries and complete amnesia. A new technological breakthrough from the Hexx Corporation - a Psi-Comp Implant that's hardwired into Luke's brain - saves his life, but Luke soon finds out that this new technology comes with a price and that the Hexx Corporation harbors sinister plans for the new device.
candidates.essence: This is a high-octane sci-fi action thriller centered on a man who awakens with amnesia and discovers he's been 'hardwired' with a dangerous corporate implant. The film delivers a relentless pace with intense action sequences as the protagonist uncovers a sinister technological conspiracy. It's a no-nonsense ride for those seeking a straightforward narrative about a lone hero fighting against a powerful, shadowy organization.

candidates.title: Zoom
candidates.synopsis: A group of older children do arts and crafts, cooking, science and technology, and games sent in by viewers.
candidates.essence: A beloved educational series designed to inspire creativity and curiosity in young viewers. It encourages hands-on learning through a variety of engaging activities, from arts and crafts to science experiments, often incorporating submissions from its audience. The show exudes a wholesome and positive energy, making it a comfort watch that fosters a sense of wonder and interactive participation for children.

candidates.title: My Kitchen Rules
candidates.synopsis: My Kitchen Rules is an Australian competitive cooking game show broadcast on the Seven Network since 2010. The series is produced by the team who created the Seven reality show My Restaurant Rules, and was put into production based on the success of Network Ten's MasterChef Australia. My Kitchen Rules has just been renewed by the Seven Network for a fifth series.
candidates.essence: A feel-good cooking competition that celebrates the art of home cooking and family dynamics. The show emphasizes the presentation and technique of culinary skills. The series offers an accessible and comforting viewing experience, perfect for casual viewing. The focus on food and friendly competition makes it an engaging and satisfying watch.

candidates.title: With Love, Meghan
candidates.synopsis: Meghan, Duchess of Sussex invites friends and famous guests to a beautiful California estate, where she shares cooking, gardening and hosting tips.
candidates.essence: A charming and aspirational lifestyle reality series featuring Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, as she shares her passions for cooking, gardening, and hosting. Set in a beautiful California estate, the show offers practical tips and insights, interwoven with friendly conversations with celebrity guests. It's a wholesome and visually pleasant experience, designed for comfort viewing and gentle escapism into a world of curated elegance and domestic warmth.

candidates.title: James May: Oh Cook!
candidates.synopsis: James May is not a chef. But that’s the whole point: you don’t need to be a brilliant cook to make delicious food. Transporting us to the Far East, the Med, and the local pub – all from the comfort of a home economist’s kitchen – he’ll knock up delicious recipes that you can actually make yourself, with ingredients you can actually buy. And all without the usual television cooking format trickery.
candidates.essence: This cooking show is a delightfully unpretentious and thoroughly wholesome guide to making delicious food accessible to everyone, not just master chefs. James May's signature dry wit and charmingly awkward approach make the educational content genuinely entertaining. It's a perfect background-friendly watch that offers comfort and practical culinary tips, proving that good food doesn't require complex techniques or obscure ingredients. The series fosters a sense of gentle learning and pure escapism into the world of simple, satisfying meals.

candidates.title: Nightflyers
candidates.synopsis: In the year 2093, a team of scientists aboard the Nightflyer, the most advanced ship ever built, embarks on a journey to find other life forms. Their mission takes them to the edge of the solar system, and to the edge of insanity, as they realize true horror isn't waiting for them in outer space—it's already on their ship.
candidates.essence: This series plunges viewers into a chilling psychological horror set aboard an advanced spaceship, where the isolation of deep space gives way to a terrifying descent into madness. It masterfully builds tension and a pervasive sense of dread, exploring the fragile line between scientific pursuit and sanity. The show’s strength lies in its ability to create an unsettling atmosphere and provide genuine scares, while posing thought-provoking questions about the human psyche under extreme duress. It's a dark and intense journey that is not for the faint of heart.

candidates.title: Skinamarink
candidates.synopsis: Two children wake up in the middle of the night to find their father is missing, and all the windows and doors in their home have vanished.
candidates.essence: An experimental and deeply unsettling horror film that plays on childhood fears and dream logic. With minimal dialogue and a focus on disorienting sound design and visual stylization, the film creates a thick atmosphere of dread. The slow burn pacing and ambiguous narrative contribute to a sense of psychological unease, leaving the viewer questioning the nature of reality. It is an intentionally alienating and challenging viewing experience, designed to provoke anxiety and disorientation.

candidates.title: Color Out of Space
candidates.synopsis: The Gardner family moves to a remote farmstead in rural New England to escape the hustle of the 21st century. They are busy adapting to their new life when a meteorite crashes into their front yard, melts into the earth, and infects both the land and the properties of space-time with a strange, otherworldly colour. To their horror, the family discovers this alien force is gradually mutating every life form that it touches—including them.
candidates.essence: A viscerally disturbing cosmic horror film that plunges a family into an increasingly nightmarish existence. It masterfully uses unsettling sound design and psychedelic visuals to depict the insidious corruption of an alien entity. The narrative is a slow, creeping descent into madness, showcasing the psychological and physical breakdown of its characters. This film is a deeply unsettling and relentless experience, pushing boundaries with its grotesque and uncanny imagery.

candidates.title: The Dark Side of the Moon
candidates.synopsis: It is the year 2022. A mysterious systems failure causes the crew of a spaceship to be stranded on the dark side of the moon, while rapidly running out of fuel and oxygen. They are surprised to discover a NASA space shuttle floating in space, and board it in the hope of salvaging some supplies. One by one, the crew is possessed and killed, and it is up to Paxton Warner to find the links between the dark side of the moon, the Bermuda Triangle, and the Devil himself.
candidates.essence: A low-budget science fiction horror film set on the dark side of the moon, where a stranded crew encounters a terrifying supernatural force. The film relies on claustrophobic tension and a sense of mystery to create a chilling atmosphere. It blends elements of demonic possession with the isolation of space exploration, resulting in a bleak and unsettling experience. Expect a slow burn with a growing sense of dread as the crew succumbs to the darkness.

candidates.title: The Endgame
candidates.synopsis: A high-stakes thriller about Elena Federova, a very recently captured international arms dealer and brilliant criminal mastermind who even in captivity orchestrates a number of coordinated bank heists, and Val Turner, the principled, relentless and socially outcast FBI agent who will stop at nothing to foil her ambitious plan.
candidates.essence: This series plunges viewers into a high-octane cat-and-mouse game between a brilliant criminal mastermind and a relentless FBI agent. It's a pulse-pounding thriller driven by strategic planning and intricate heists, keeping audiences on the edge of their seats. The narrative excels in crafting a compelling psychological duel between its two formidable leads. Expect intense suspense and a fast-paced plot that demands full attention from beginning to end.

candidates.title: Inside Man
candidates.synopsis: When an armed, masked gang enter a Manhattan bank, lock the doors and take hostages, the detective assigned to effect their release enters negotiations preoccupied with corruption charges he is facing.
candidates.essence: 'Inside Man' is a masterclass in clever heist thrillers, characterized by its intricate plot and the gripping psychological battle between a seasoned detective and a cunning bank robber. The film thrives on sharp dialogue, a non-linear narrative, and a constant sense of intrigue, keeping viewers guessing until the very end. It's a sophisticated and highly rewatchable crime drama that subverts genre expectations while delivering thrilling suspense. An absolute must-watch for fans of intelligent thrillers.

candidates.title: Carnage Park
candidates.synopsis: Part crime caper gone awry, part survival horror film, this 1970s set thriller depicts a harrowing fight for survival after a pair of wannabe crooks botch a bank heist and flee into the desert, where they inexplicably stumble upon Carnage Park, a remote stretch of wilderness occupied by a psychotic ex-military sniper.
candidates.essence: A brutal and unrelenting survival horror film set in the 1970s, where a botched bank heist leads a group of criminals into a deadly game of cat and mouse with a psychotic ex-military sniper. The film revels in its grindhouse aesthetic, delivering a visceral and disturbing experience. Viewers should expect a relentless barrage of violence and tension, with little room for respite or hope.

candidates.title: The Immortals
candidates.synopsis: An elaborate heist unites 8 strangers in a simultaneous assault on targets all over the city- and explodes in a hailstorm of gunfire and high-speed chases in this powerful action-thriller.  Recruited by a Mafia nightclub owner (Eric Roberts), 4 teams launch a brutal cross-town attack to retrieve suitcases full of cash.  But as the violence escalates, the team members discover just who their real target has been all along - and the shocking truth they have in common.
candidates.essence: An elaborate heist unites a group of strangers in a simultaneous assault across the city, exploding into a hailstorm of gunfire and high-speed chases. Recruited by a Mafia nightclub owner, the teams discover their true target and a shocking truth they share. This action-thriller is defined by its intricate plot, betrayals, and violent set pieces. It's a high-stakes game of cat and mouse where everyone has a hidden agenda.

candidates.title: Takers
candidates.synopsis: A seasoned team of bank robbers, including Gordon Jennings, John Rahway, A.J., and brothers Jake and Jesse Attica successfully complete their latest heist and lead a life of luxury while planning their next job. When Ghost, a former member of their team, is released from prison he convinces the group to strike an armored car carrying $20 million. As the "Takers" carefully plot out their strategy and draw nearer to exacting the grand heist, a reckless police officer inches closer to apprehending the criminals.
candidates.essence: Takers is a high-octane heist thriller brimming with adrenaline-fueled action sequences and a relentless pace. The film centers on a group of professional bank robbers caught in a tense cat-and-mouse game with a determined police officer. It delivers strong spectacle through its meticulously planned heists and explosive confrontations. Viewers can expect a gripping crime drama focused on strategic maneuvers, loyalty, and the high risks of a life of crime.

candidates.title: Anne
candidates.synopsis: Anne Williams, from Formby, near Liverpool, was devastated by the loss of her son, 15-year-old Kevin, who was tragically killed at the FA Cup semi-final in 1989 between Liverpool and Nottingham Forest. Anne stood defiantly alongside other parents and their families who fought for justice for the 96 loved ones who lost their lives at a football match.
candidates.essence: A poignant and powerful biographical drama, 'Anne' meticulously recounts the true story of a mother's unwavering fight for justice after the tragic loss of her son. The series is emotionally intense, highlighting the devastating impact of historical injustice and the remarkable resilience of the human spirit. It serves as a compelling social commentary, gripping viewers with its raw portrayal of grief and the tireless pursuit of truth. This is a must-watch for those seeking a deeply moving and thought-provoking narrative based on real events.

candidates.title: Crash
candidates.synopsis: After losing his wife and daughter in a terrorist act, Kadir Adalı decides to attempt suicide via car accident, unwittingly changing the course of his life and the three others involved in the accident.
candidates.essence: This is a gripping and emotionally charged Turkish drama that intricately weaves the fates of four disparate individuals after a profound, life-altering car accident. It delves deep into themes of grief, despair, and the search for meaning amidst chaos, maintaining a relentless tension throughout. The series is a psychologically intense experience, exploring the dark undercurrents of human connection and the possibility of redemption, making it a compelling, albeit heavy, watch.

candidates.title: The Missing
candidates.synopsis: A gripping anthological relationship thriller series exploring the emotional fallout of a child's abduction not only on the family but on the wider community, told over two time frames.
candidates.essence: A gripping and emotionally intense anthology series that delves into the devastating aftermath of a child's abduction. Told through non-linear timelines, the show explores the psychological impact on the family and community, creating a pervasive atmosphere of suspense and dread. The series examines themes of grief, obsession, and the enduring power of hope, even in the face of unimaginable loss. Prepare for a slow-burn narrative that demands attention and offers a hauntingly realistic portrayal of trauma.

candidates.title: Broadchurch
candidates.synopsis: The murder of a young boy in a small coastal town brings a media frenzy, which threatens to tear the community apart.
candidates.essence: A masterclass in character-driven crime drama, this series delivers relentless tension as it unravels the devastating impact of a young boy's murder on a close-knit coastal community. It’s an unflinching exploration of grief, suspicion, and the relentless glare of media attention. The series excels with its intricate mystery, compelling performances, and a haunting atmosphere that perfectly captures the town's unraveling. This is a powerful, emotionally charged viewing experience that lingers long after the credits roll.

candidates.title: Pieces of a Woman
candidates.synopsis: When a young mother's home birth ends in unfathomable tragedy, she begins a year-long odyssey of mourning that fractures relationships with loved ones in this deeply personal story of a woman learning to live alongside her loss.
candidates.essence: A deeply personal and emotionally raw exploration of grief, loss, and fractured family relationships. Anchored by a powerhouse performance, the film unflinchingly portrays the year-long odyssey of a young mother grappling with unimaginable tragedy. It's a harrowing and intimate character study that demands patience and emotional investment from the viewer. The experience is profoundly moving, leaving a lasting impact through its unflinching realism and palpable sense of sorrow.

candidates.title: Manchester by the Sea
candidates.synopsis: After his older brother passes away, Lee Chandler is forced to return home to care for his 16-year-old nephew. There he is compelled to deal with a tragic past that separated him from his family and the community where he was born and raised.
candidates.essence: A deeply affecting and profoundly melancholic drama that unflinchingly explores the depths of grief and unresolved trauma. This film is a masterful character study, anchored by a devastating lead performance, that immerses viewers in the somber realities of a fractured family and a man haunted by his past. Its quiet intensity and raw emotional honesty create a powerful, unforgettable experience that resonates long after viewing.

candidates.title: Static
candidates.synopsis: A couple facing marital problems after losing their child finds their life together further complicated by a mysterious visitor.
candidates.essence: A tense and unsettling psychological thriller exploring the fragile nature of a marriage strained by grief. The arrival of a mysterious stranger escalates the couple's internal struggles, leading to a desperate fight for survival. The film creates a palpable sense of dread and paranoia, leaving the viewer questioning the characters' motives and perceptions. It's a slow-burn experience with a focus on character depth and psychological realism.

candidates.title: Dear Zachary: A Letter to a Son About His Father
candidates.synopsis: In 2001, Andrew Bagby, a medical resident, is murdered not long after breaking up with his girlfriend. Soon after, when she announces she's pregnant, one of Andrew's many close friends, Kurt Kuenne, begins this film, a gift to the child.
candidates.essence: A deeply moving and heartbreaking documentary crafted as a letter to a son about his father. The film explores themes of grief, loss, and family tragedy with unflinching honesty. It is a powerful, biographical account of a true crime story, designed to be both a tribute and a reckoning. Prepare for an emotionally challenging but ultimately cathartic experience.

candidates.title: The Lighthouse
candidates.synopsis: Two lighthouse keepers clash, making their duties difficult even before a freak storms hits and strands them at the lighthouse for months. Based on a true story.
candidates.essence: A descent into madness unfolds within the confines of a remote, storm-battered lighthouse.  The film creates a suffocating atmosphere through its stark black and white cinematography and oppressive sound design.  Two keepers are trapped together and their sanity erodes, blurring the line between reality and nightmare.  A psychological horror story unfolds, exploring themes of isolation, paranoia, and the supernatural. This is a visually striking, intense experience that lingers long after the credits roll.

candidates.title: The Light Between Oceans
candidates.synopsis: A lighthouse keeper and his wife living off the coast of Western Australia raise a baby they rescue from an adrift rowboat.
candidates.essence: A visually stunning and emotionally resonant romantic drama set against the backdrop of a remote lighthouse. The film explores themes of love, loss, and moral dilemmas as a couple grapples with a life-altering decision. With its poignant performances and breathtaking cinematography, it evokes a sense of melancholy and reflection on the complexities of human relationships. This is a heart-wrenching story about love and the consequences of choices.

candidates.title: Blood Drive
candidates.synopsis: Set in a near-dystopian future, a former cop is forced to take part in a death race where the cars run on human blood. You lose a leg and you lose your head.
candidates.essence: A relentlessly high-octane dystopian thrill ride, this series fully embraces its grindhouse aesthetic with audacious visual stylization and extreme violence. It plunges viewers into a nightmarish death race where survival means literally running on blood, delivering a shocking spectacle. The show blends dark humor, social commentary, and over-the-top action to create a unique and often unsettling escapist experience. It's a deliberate homage to B-movies, offering visceral thrills and provocative themes.

candidates.title: Eureka
candidates.synopsis: The sleepy Pacific Northwest town of Eureka is hiding a mysterious secret. The government has been relocating the world's geniuses and their families to this rustic town for years where innovation and chaos have lived hand in hand. U.S. Marshal Jack Carter stumbles upon this odd town after wrecking his car and becoming stranded there. When the denizens of the town unleash an unknown scientific creation, Carter jumps in to try to restore order and consequently learns of one of the country's best kept secrets.
candidates.essence: A quirky and intriguing sci-fi series set in a seemingly idyllic Pacific Northwest town harboring a secret community of geniuses. The show blends small-town mystery with futuristic technology, creating a world where innovation and chaos collide. Driven by strong characters and intriguing storylines, it offers an entertaining mix of suspense, humor, and technological wonder. This is a binge-worthy series that balances escapism with thought-provoking concepts.

candidates.title: The Last Chase
candidates.synopsis: Twenty years after the American people have been told the oil has run out and disease has scared them into complacency, the United States has become a fascist state. One man, former race car driver Franklyn Hart, now a puppet spokesman for public transportation, rebuilds his race car and sets off to California from Boston where people have returned to living life like they were twenty years prior.
candidates.essence: This is a high-concept sci-fi chase movie straight out of the early 80s, fueled by anxieties about fuel shortages and authoritarian overreach. The experience is centered on a lone rebel's defiant cross-country drive against a conformist, totalitarian state. It's a film about individualism and freedom, told through the lens of a straightforward action narrative. Viewers should expect fast-paced car action, a clear political allegory, and a distinctly retro-futuristic aesthetic.

candidates.title: Death Race
candidates.synopsis: Terminal Island, New York: 2020. Overcrowding in the US penal system has reached a breaking point. Prisons have been turned over to a monolithic Weyland Corporation, which sees jails full of thugs as an opportunity for televised sport. Adrenalized inmates, a global audience hungry for violence and a spectacular, enclosed arena come together to form the 'Death Race', the biggest, most brutal event.
candidates.essence: This is a relentless, high-octane action film set in a brutal dystopian future where prisoners compete in televised, deadly car races. It delivers on visceral violence and explosive car combat, designed for pure adrenaline-fueled escapism. The narrative is straightforward, prioritizing spectacle and fast-paced thrills over deep character development or complex themes. It's a no-holds-barred experience for fans of aggressive, demolition derby-style cinema.

candidates.title: Dragon Tales
candidates.synopsis: Two siblings, Max and Emmy, find an enchanted dragon scale capable of transporting them to a whimsical fantasy land inhabited by colorful anthropomorphic dragons by reciting a rhyme. They befriend four friendly dragons Cassie, Ord, Zak, Wheezie and Quetzal.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and imaginative series for young audiences, this show is a portal to a vibrant world filled with friendly dragons and gentle adventures. It fosters a sense of wonder and encourages positive social skills through its wholesome narratives. The colorful animation and simple, engaging stories make it a comforting and educational watch for children and families alike. It's designed for pure escapism into a world where friendship and learning are paramount.

candidates.title: The Story of the Voyages
candidates.synopsis: In this fantasy with dragons and flying machines, 10-year-old Marta is determined to find her brother who was kidnapped at Christmastime by a fake Saint Nick because the little boy is blessed with the ability to locate gold. A kindly, wise philosopher-type by the name of Orlando joins Marta in her search, and together they survive a gigantic sleeping dragon and imprisonment in a tower with no clear means of escape. They overcome that hurdle, but later on, Orlando succumbs to the evils of The Plague (an all-consuming woman!) and Marta continues on her search alone. Eventually, she does find her brother -- but that only introduces problems she had never considered.
candidates.essence: A fantastical journey across a landscape filled with mythical creatures and moral quandaries. The film centers around a child's unwavering determination to reunite with family, guided by a wise companion. Ornate visuals and a touch of surrealism amplify the sense of wonder and danger. It's a story about growing up, the corrupting nature of power, and the enduring strength of familial love, leaving the viewer to ponder the nature of good and evil.

candidates.title: How to Train Your Dragon
candidates.synopsis: As the son of a Viking leader on the cusp of manhood, shy Hiccup Horrendous Haddock III faces a rite of passage: he must kill a dragon to prove his warrior mettle. But after downing a feared dragon, he realizes that he no longer wants to destroy it, and instead befriends the beast – which he names Toothless – much to the chagrin of his warrior father.
candidates.essence: A soaring, visually stunning fantasy adventure about a young Viking who befriends a dragon, defying the traditions of his tribe. The film blends heartwarming moments with thrilling action sequences, creating a world of wonder and excitement. Its themes of friendship, acceptance, and defying expectations resonate deeply, amplified by a memorable musical score. This is an immersive experience that appeals to all ages, filled with both spectacle and emotional depth.

candidates.title: Jack Frost
candidates.synopsis: Pardon-me Pete, the official groundhog of Groundhog Day, tells the story of Jack Frost, who falls in love with a beautiful young woman and begs Father Winter to make him human so that she can see him. His request is granted, but only on the condition that by the Spring he has a house, a bag of gold, a horse and a wife. But Jack finds that life as a human is more complicated than he thought.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and nostalgic animated tale about Jack Frost's quest to become human and find love. This classic holiday special blends fantasy with a redemptive narrative, creating a wholesome experience for all ages. With a charming 2D animation style and a touching story, it evokes feelings of wonder and sentimental longing. The special explores themes of sacrifice and the true meaning of happiness, wrapped in a family-friendly package.

candidates.title: About Time
candidates.synopsis: The night after another unsatisfactory New Year's party, Tim's father reveals to him that the men in their family have the ability to travel through time. They can't change history, but they can change what happens and has happened in their own lives. Thus begins the start of a lesson in learning to appreciate life itself as it is, as it comes, and most importantly, the people living alongside us.
candidates.essence: A heartwarming and profoundly charming romantic dramedy that uses a unique time-travel conceit to explore universal themes of love, family, and appreciating life's everyday moments. It's a journey of personal growth and connection, rich with emotional depth and genuine humor, often leaving viewers with a powerful sense of hope and gratitude. The film is a beloved comfort watch, perfect for quiet reflection or a cozy date night.

candidates.title: A Time Called You
candidates.synopsis: A grieving woman magically travels through time to 1998, where she meets a man with an uncanny resemblance to her late love.
candidates.essence: This poignant Korean drama weaves a complex tale of romance, grief, and mysterious time travel, as a woman yearning for her lost love finds herself in the past. It masterfully blends a compelling mystery with a deeply emotional narrative, exploring themes of destiny and connection across timelines. With strong character depth and a non-linear structure, it's a thought-provoking and immersive experience that invites dedicated binge-watching.

candidates.title: Looper
candidates.synopsis: In the year 2044, time travel has not yet been invented but in 30 years it will have been. When the mob wants to get rid of someone, they will send their target into the past where a looper, a hired gun, like Joe is waiting to mop up. Joe is getting rich and life is good until the day the mob decides to close the loop, sending back Joe's future self for assassination.
candidates.essence: A sophisticated sci-fi thriller that plunges viewers into a complex world of time travel and assassins. The film masterfully blends high-octane action with profound psychological and philosophical questions, creating intense tension and a grim, futuristic atmosphere. Its intricate narrative structure keeps you on the edge, while compelling performances ground the challenging premise. 'Looper' is a thought-provoking and visually striking journey that redefines the genre.

candidates.title: Timecrimes
candidates.synopsis: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.
candidates.essence: This ingenious time-travel thriller is a masterclass in escalating tension and intricate plotting. What begins as a simple accident spirals into a nightmarish loop of paradoxes and unforeseen consequences, demanding the viewer's full attention. Its low-budget aesthetic belies a deeply clever and psychologically unsettling narrative that explores the ripple effects of tampering with time. It's a gripping, self-contained puzzle box that rewards careful viewing and discussion.
